data_description.hosts: Comma-separated IPs of every OpenWrt device. Roles (gateway, access point, switch) are detected automatically — you don't choose them. Inline SSH ports are supported: 192.168.1.1:2222, [2001:db8::1]:2222. To force a role, append =gateway, =ap, or =switch to an IP, e.g. 192.168.1.5=switch; use =gateway for an all-in-one router that also serves Wi-Fi (gateway already includes its Wi-Fi). Example: 192.168.1.1,192.168.1.22,192.168.1.24
data_description.ssh_key_path: Absolute path to the SSH private key on the HA host used to authenticate as root. Example: /config/ssh/id_ed25519

data_description.hosts: Comma-separated IPs of every OpenWrt device. Roles (gateway, access point, switch) are detected automatically and re-detected on every reload. Inline SSH ports are supported: 192.168.1.1:2222, [2001:db8::1]:2222. To force a role, append =gateway, =ap, or =switch to an IP, e.g. 192.168.1.5=switch; use =gateway for an all-in-one router that also serves Wi-Fi. Example: 192.168.1.1,192.168.1.22,192.168.1.24
data_description.ssh_key_path: Absolute path to the SSH private key on the HA host. Example: /config/ssh/id_ed25519
data_description.lan_iface: Leave blank to autodetect from the gateway (the interface that holds its LAN IP, usually br-lan). Set a value only to override which interface device discovery reads.
data_description.wan_iface: Leave blank to autodetect from the gateway (its default-route interface, e.g. eth0 or pppoe-wan). Set a value only to override which interface WAN byte counters are read from.
data_description.disconnect_threshold_s: How long a device must be absent before a disconnect event is recorded. Default: 120 s (2 missed scans at 60 s interval).
data_description.presence_macs: Comma-separated MAC addresses to track as presence binary sensors. Each MAC becomes a binary_sensor.wrtsensor_presence_* entity. Example: aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff,11:22:33:44:55:66
data_description.enable_network_hosts: Discover devices on the LAN, expose a device_tracker per client, and surface them through the network scanner sensor and presence binary sensors. Disable to skip ARP/NDP/Wi-Fi station/conntrack collection on every host. Required by the network topology, table, and events cards. Default: on.
data_description.enable_wan_bandwidth: Read RX/TX byte counters on the gateway's WAN interface and expose WAN download/upload sensors. Requires a detected gateway. Default: on.
data_description.enable_dns_stats: Signal dnsmasq each scan to collect cache hit-rate, latency, and per-upstream history for the DNS stats card. Disable to skip the SIGUSR1 + logread on every scan and the DNS history file I/O. Requires a detected gateway. Default: on.
data_description.enable_host_metrics: Collect CPU, RAM, and root storage usage for every configured OpenWrt host, then expose per-host sensors. Disable to skip those commands and remove the CPU/RAM/Disk entities on reload. Default: on.
data_description.enable_wireguard: Auto-detect WireGuard on the gateway and APs each scan, then expose per-peer device_trackers and a card with handshake age, transfer totals, and live rate. Hosts without `wg` installed are skipped silently. Private and preshared keys are never read into HA — only public keys, descriptions, endpoints, and counters. Default: off.
data_description.wg_stale_threshold_s: Peers whose last handshake is older than this go to not_home and grey out in the card. WireGuard handshakes every ~2 minutes when active. Default: 180.
data_description.enable_asu: Add an Update entity per OpenWrt host that polls the OpenWrt Attended Sysupgrade service every few hours via the device's `owut` tool. OpenWrt 25.12 images include owut by default on devices with larger flash storage; otherwise install it with `opkg update && opkg install owut` on 24.10 or `apk -U add owut` on 25.12/main. Each entity exposes a LuCI link to that host's Attended Sysupgrade page — click it to perform the actual upgrade. Default: off.
